verses.text: "Speak to the people of Israel and get twelve walking sticks from them, one from the leader of each ancestral tribe. Write each leader's name on his stick.
On the stick for Levi, write Aaron's name. There must be one stick for the head of each ancestral tribe.
Put them in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Covenant Box, where I meet with you.
The stick of the man I choose will sprout buds. In this way I will put a stop to the constant complaining of the people of Israel against you."
So Moses spoke to the people of Israel, and their leaders gave him twelve sticks, one for each leader of an ancestral tribe. Aaron's stick was among them.
Moses placed the sticks before the LORD in the Tent of the Covenant Law.
The next day Moses went into the Tent of the Covenant Law, and he saw that Aaron's stick, which stood for the tribe of Levi, had sprouted. It had put out buds, opened flowers, and grown ripe almonds!
Moses brought all the sticks out from before the LORD and showed them to the people of Israel. They looked, and each leader took back his own stick.
The LORD said to Moses, "Put Aaron's stick back in front of the Covenant Box. Keep it there as a warning to those who rebel, so that their complaining against me will stop and they will not die."
Moses did just as the LORD commanded him.
The people of Israel said to Moses, "We are going to die! We are lost, all of us are lost!
Anyone who even comes near the LORD's Holy Tent will die. Are we all going to die?"
